wt_iew_maximum_execution_time.note: admin/modules/import/import.php:119-132: authored execution-time preference, consumed by imports; native Save stores an integer.

wt_iew_enable_import_log.note: admin/modules/import/import.php:135-145: authored logging toggle; generated logs and imported records remain runtime.

wt_iew_default_import_method.note: admin/modules/import/import.php:147-156: default wizard method; native source quick and target template were Saved and reopened.

wt_iew_default_import_batch.note: admin/modules/import/import.php:157-164: authored batch size, not an entity ID.

wt_iew_default_export_method.note: admin/modules/export/export.php:132-145: default export wizard method; source and target native Saves diverged.

wt_iew_default_export_batch.note: admin/modules/export/export.php:154-164: authored batch size, not an entity ID.

wt_iew_enable_history_auto_delete.note: admin/modules/history/history.php:242-253: authored retention toggle. Applying configuration must not replay after_advanced_setting_update or purge operational history.

wt_iew_auto_delete_history_count.note: admin/modules/history/history.php:257-272: authored history retention limit, not a history row ID.

wt_iew_include_bom.note: admin/modules/export/export.php:146-153: authored CSV BOM toggle; native unchecked value is integer 0 and checked value is string 1.

wt_iew_advanced_settings.note: Shared settings container: only these nine native user-importer controls are owned. Other module keys remain target-local and must survive partial Apply.

wt_iew_admin_modules.note: admin/class-wt-import-export-for-woo-admin.php:425-448: active module initialization flags, not portable settings.

notes: Experimental 2.7.5 settings capsule. Nine controls were Saved and reopened natively on two disposable sites; capsule conformance and production readiness remain pending.

Authored mapping templates are not classified runtime: their selected-user codec is available, but complete template identity, header mappings and target-local CSV input semantics remain outside this milestone. Operational history, generated exports/logs, imported users and customer data are never authored settings.

The native settings Save invokes wt_iew_after_advanced_setting_update_basic, whose history listener can delete files and records. WPrism must materialize configuration without replaying this operational action.
